crossRefs.note: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is…
Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
No one is greater in this house than I am, and he has not kept back anything from me but you, because you are his wife.…
My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments.
Wail, for Yahweh’s day is at hand! It will come as destruction from the Almighty.
Alas for the day! For the day of Yahweh is at hand, and it will come as destruction from the Almighty.
Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed…

translations.web: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.
translations.bsb: For calamity from God terrifies me, and His splendor I cannot overpower.
